headword: {卸売価格|おろしうりかかく}

definitions.explanation: The price at which goods are sold in bulk by a wholesaler to a retailer, before being marked up for sale to the end consumer. Lower than the retail price.

examples.japanese: {卸売価格|おろしうりかかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕入|しい}れた→仕入れる：11430_shiireru⟧。
{卸売価格|おろしうりかかく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{小売価格|こうりかかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The difference between the wholesale price and retail price becomes the profit.

examples.japanese: {原材料費|げんざいりょうひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高騰|こうとう}→高騰：14647_koutou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、{卸売価格|おろしうりかかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}→上昇：11296_joushou⟧し、⟦{小売店|こうりてん}→小売店：20689_kouriten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Due to soaring raw material costs, wholesale prices have risen, and the impact is being felt by retail stores as well.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{卸売|おろしうり}→卸売：05083_oroshiuri⟧ (wholesale) and ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ (price). Used in business, economics, and news reporting about market trends and pricing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卸売価格|おろしうりかかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at wholesale price
- {卸売価格|おろしうりかかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: wholesale prices rise
- {卸売価格|おろしうりかかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: wholesale prices fall
- {卸売価格|おろしうりかかく}⟦{指数|しすう}→指数：20414_shisuu⟧: wholesale price index

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小売価格|こうりかかく}: retail price — the price paid by the end consumer
- ⟦{仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}→仕入れ値：21592_shiirene⟧: purchase price; cost price — the price a shop pays for stock, similar but more colloquial
- ⟦{希望小売価格|きぼうこうりかかく}→希望小売価格：29233_kiboukourikakaku⟧: manufacturer's suggested retail price (MSRP)
- ⟦{定価|ていか}→定価：04066_teika⟧: list price; fixed price
